frames.review: The body pose is closer to the guide, but the painted sword points down-right instead of the guide's up-right wind-up.
The sword axis matches the guide, but the cloak and full silhouette pop against adjacent painted frames.

decision: Do not admit these frame-specific full-character generations to the master. Rebuild the action from a shared high-resolution painted master and registered layer/cutout workflow, then audit every body landmark and weapon axis against its matching Blender pose.
